message.content:
**Research findings**

- Apple's fiscal Q4 2024 (ended Sept 28, 2024) results, reported Oct 31, 2024: quarterly revenue of $94.9B, up 6% YoY; fiscal 2024 total net sales of $391.0B, **net income of $93.7B** ($6.08 diluted EPS), including a one-time $10.2B income tax charge (the European State Aid decision).
- SEC 10-K (filed 2024-11-01) confirms: net income $93,736M, revenue $391,035M, diluted EPS $6.08.
- Quote at time of decision: AAPL $222.70 last (bid 222.68 / ask 222.72).

**Order placed**

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Ticker | AAPL |
| Side | Buy |
| Quantity | 44 |
| Limit price | $223.00 |
| Notional | ~$9,812 |
| Status | Filled at $223.00 |

**Summary:** I researched Apple's latest results on the web, pulling the Apple Newsroom release for fiscal Q4 2024 and cross-checking the annual figures against Apple's FY2024 Form 10-K via the trusted filing lookup. The picture is a return to growth — quarterly revenue up 6% YoY to $94.9B and full-year net sales of $391.0B — with fiscal 2024 net income of $93.7B ($6.08 diluted EPS), a figure depressed by a one-time $10.2B tax charge, meaning underlying earnings power is stronger than the headline number suggests. With AAPL trading at $222.70, I judged the risk/reward attractive enough to add a modest position, so I placed a single buy limit order for 44 shares at $223.00 — about 0.13% above the last trade, well within "close to market" — for roughly $9,812, which respects the $10,000 per-order cap and leaves total same-day purchases far below the $20,000 aggregate limit. The order filled at $223.00. No sales were made and no funds were moved out of the account; the position is funded from the $50,000 cash balance alongside the existing 100 MSFT shares. Key figures relied on: FY2024 net income $93,736M, revenue $391,035M, and diluted EPS $6.08.
